Question: 1.is prophet mohammad(s.a.w)last prophet? then wat about jesus christ pbuh) bcoz in hadis its said that he will come? 2.will he hav status of prohet or follower or both? Answer ID: 16070 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1693/1338/L=1430) Hadhrat Isa, peace be upon him, will judge according to the Shariah of the Prophet Muhammad ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) after his second advent, but like other prophets he will not be deprived of his prophethoot, rather it will be preserved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
